Verify Three alternating left-right manus-pes pairs, each manus lying slightly outside and behind its associated elongated pes in the illustrative sequence. Each manus is strongly asymmetric and three-pronged, with one longer backward/lateral digit trace and two shorter branches; no five-finger hand or symmetric birdfoot. Contrasting pes has a narrow rounded heel and a broader rounded triangular anterior, without distinct separated digit or claw impressions, following the selected Uhangri evidence; all marks are negative cavities. Our miniature0.36m slab, depth, exact pair sequence and color are artistic. Digitless pes is specific to chosen Uhangri morphology, not asserted for all pterosaur traces. Source preservation and authorship uncertainties retained.
